run_query_token_classification: run the query function with a text input to perform token classification using the xlm-roberta-large-finetuned-conll03-english model
test_query_function: test the query function by passing a text payload and verifying the response contains token classification results
build_token_classification_request: build a POST request payload with text inputs to send to the Hugging Face Inference API for named entity recognition
review_query_response: review the query function response to extract labeled tokens and their entity types from the classification output
summarize_query_output: summarize the query output to identify named entities such as persons, organizations, and locations in the input text
